message.content:
This editorial illustration features the lower torso and legs of a person standing against a pale yellow background. The person wears a short-sleeved sage green shirt tucked into dark grey trousers with a black belt and a large gold-colored buckle. A gold watch with a dark, complex face is on their left wrist. Their hands are clenched into fists at their sides. They wear polished black dress shoes.

The main headline, "KOMANDO TEROR AIR KERAS," is in bold black capital letters. Below it, smaller black text mentions "Polisi," "Badan Intelijen Strategis TNI," "Andrie Yunus," and "Bais." Red letters spell out "TEMPO" across the center, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Other text includes "Alarm Ekonomi Kredit Seret UMKM H.90" and "Setelah Izin Toba Pulp Lestari Dicabut H.74."

Dripping from the person’s right side and forming a trail of splatters across the floor are several bright green, viscous-looking liquid droplets. In the bottom right corner, a barcode, a QR code, and publication details dated "30 MARET-5 APRIL 2026" are visible.
